welcome.turnAnySong: Turn any song into a professional karaoke video in minutes.
welcome.freeCreditsNote: Each credit creates one professional karaoke video
welcome.step1Desc: Enter the artist and title, and we'll find high-quality audio.
welcome.step2Desc: We separate vocals, transcribe lyrics, and sync everything perfectly.
welcome.step3Desc: Fine-tune the lyrics if needed, choose your instrumental.
welcome.step4Desc: Download your 4K karaoke video or upload directly to YouTube.

creditDenied.subject: About your Nomad Karaoke free credits
creditDenied.thankYou: Thanks for signing up for Nomad Karaoke!
creditDenied.deniedMessage: Unfortunately, we weren't able to grant your free {credit_type} this time. Our system detected patterns that suggest this may not be your first account with us, and each karaoke generation job costs us real money in cloud computing and API fees.
creditDenied.mistakeNote: We totally understand if this is a mistake! If you're a genuine new user, please just reply to this email and let Andrew (the founder) know. He built this service and is happy to grant you some free credits to try it out — he just asks that you provide honest feedback on the experience in return.
creditDenied.buyPrompt: If you'd like to get started right away, you can also purchase credits:
creditDenied.costNote: We keep costs low so we can offer the service affordably, which means we need to be careful about free credit abuse. Thanks for understanding!

jobCompletion.youtubeLink: Here's the link for the karaoke video published to YouTube:
jobCompletion.dropboxIntro: Here's the dropbox folder with all the finished files and source files, including:
jobCompletion.fileList:
- "(Final Karaoke Lossless).mkv": combined karaoke video in 4k H264 with lossless FLAC audio
- "(Final Karaoke).mp4": combined karaoke video with title/end screen in 4k H264/AAC
- "(Final Karaoke 720p).mp4": combined karaoke video in 720p H264/AAC (smaller file for older systems)
- "(With Vocals).mp4": sing along video in 4k H264/AAC with original vocals
- "(Karaoke).mov": karaoke video output from MidiCo (no title/end screen)
- "(Title).mov"/"(End).mov": title card and end screen videos
- "(Final Karaoke CDG).zip": CDG+MP3 format for older/commercial karaoke systems
- "(Final Karaoke TXT).zip": TXT+MP3 format for Power Karaoke
- stems/*.flac: various separated instrumental and vocal audio stems in lossless format
- lyrics/*.txt song lyrics from various sources in plain text format
jobCompletion.fixOffer: Let me know if anything isn't perfect and I'll happily tweak / fix, or if you need it in any other format I can probably convert it for you!
jobCompletion.feedbackRequest: If you have a moment, I'd really appreciate your feedback (takes 2 minutes):
jobCompletion.signOff:
Thanks again and have a great day!
-Andrew

karaokehuntConversion.subject: Your karaoke request: {artist} - {title}
karaokehuntConversion.intro: You just requested a karaoke track through the KaraokeHunt app. That app is retired and no longer supported - it has grown up into Nomad Karaoke (gen.nomadkaraoke.com) - but your request still reached us, and we've taken care of it one last time.
karaokehuntConversion.jobStarted: Good news: we're making your track right now.
karaokehuntConversion.jobDetail: We've started generating a full karaoke video for {artist} - {title}. We'll email you when it's ready - usually within a few hours.
karaokehuntConversion.newAccountNote: We set up a free Nomad Karaoke account for this email address, and this first video is on us.
karaokehuntConversion.usedCreditNote: This used 1 credit from your existing Nomad Karaoke account. Not what you wanted? Just reply to this email and we'll restore it.
karaokehuntConversion.parkedIntro: Your request needs one quick tap from you.
karaokehuntConversion.parkedDetail: We couldn't confidently pick the right audio recording for {artist} - {title} automatically. Sign in below, choose the recording (it takes about 10 seconds), and we'll generate your karaoke video from there.
karaokehuntConversion.boardIntro: Your song is on the free community requests board.
karaokehuntConversion.boardDetail: Your Nomad Karaoke account is out of credits, so we've added {artist} - {title} to our free community requests board - every day the top-voted request gets made for free. Vote for your song to move it up the queue, or grab credits to make it instantly.
karaokehuntConversion.communityIntro: Good news: this song already has a karaoke version you can sing right now.
karaokehuntConversion.communityDetail: A community karaoke version of {artist} - {title} already exists on YouTube - free and ready now, no need to wait for us to generate one.
karaokehuntConversion.communityCreditNoteNew: We've also set up a free Nomad Karaoke account for this email address, with 1 free credit you can use any time to generate your own studio-quality custom version of any song.
karaokehuntConversion.communityCreditNoteExisting: Your Nomad Karaoke credits weren't touched - sign in any time if you'd like to generate your own studio-quality custom version instead.
karaokehuntConversion.communityBonus: Bonus: a community karaoke version of this song already exists on YouTube - you can sing it right now:
karaokehuntConversion.whyEmail: Why this email? A song request was submitted in the retired KaraokeHunt app using this address. This is a one-time message about that request - there's no mailing list behind it. Questions? Just reply: a real human (Andrew, the founder) reads everything.
karaokehuntConversion.uninstallNote: One important thing: this was a one-time conversion. Future requests made through the old KaraokeHunt app won't be processed, so please uninstall it and make your karaoke tracks directly at gen.nomadkaraoke.com from now on - your account is ready there.
karaokehuntConversion.uninstallIntro: You just made a song request through the KaraokeHunt app - but that app is retired and no longer supported, and this request was not processed.
karaokehuntConversion.uninstallDetail: You've already received your one-time free conversion from us, so requests through the old app (like this one for {artist} - {title}) no longer do anything. To make karaoke tracks, sign in at gen.nomadkaraoke.com instead - same account, and it does far more than the old app ever did.
